parameters.name: HNDDeviceClass
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the supported DLNA Home Network Device Classes {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG|Table 4-1}}.

parameters.name: DeviceCapability
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the supported DLNA Device Capabilities {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG|Table 4-2}}.

parameters.name: HIDDeviceClass
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the supported DLNA Home Infrastructure Device Classes {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG|Table 4-4}}.

parameters.name: ImageClassProfileID
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the DLNA Image Class Profile IDs supported by this device, from Tables 5-2 and 5-3 of {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG}}.

parameters.name: AudioClassProfileID
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the DLNA Audio Class Profile IDs supported by this device, from Tables 5-4 through 5-10 of {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG}}.

parameters.name: AVClassProfileID
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the DLNA AV Class Profile IDs supported by this device, from Tables 5-11 through 5-15 of {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG}}.

parameters.name: MediaCollectionProfileID
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the DLNA Media Collection Profile IDs supported by this device {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG|Table 5-16}}.

parameters.name: PrinterClassProfileID
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the DLNA Printer Class Profile IDs supported by this device {{bibref|DLNA-NDIG|Table 5-17}}.
